messages:
sara: quick afternoon sync — release train is moving. master CI green but eu-west2 canary is flaky after kernel roll, so we’re holding full rollout. 3 cherry-picks in queue (two bugfix, one perf). any blockers? :clock4:

mike: thanks — looking at the canary logs now, seeing repeated OOMs in transformer-service pod around step 12. might be a memory leak after the runtime patch.

jen: pinging eng-infra — @kevin any idea if the kernel rollback window is still open?

kevin: yes window open for another 45m. we can roll back the kernel on eu-west2 nodes but it'll trigger node restarts, so expect some transient 503s. recommended: do a canary-specific rollback (only nodes serving canary pool).

anita: for cherry-picks: 1) backport fix for tokenizer edge-case (PR #4321) 2) small fix for batching config (PR #4330) 3) perf tweak for KV cache sharding (PR #4335). I can land 1 and 2 after CI re-run. PR 4335 needs an extra perf regression eval.

mike: re-run CI on 4321/4330 started:
```
# trigger commands
/ci re-run 4321
/ci re-run 4330
```

release-bot: deploy-canary started for version v2.14.0-canary.09 -> eu-west2. status: rolling (3/6 pods up). logs: https://ci.internal/release/1818002468

jen: if canary health stabilizes after rollback, we can cut the full train in ~1h. if not, we hold and start cherrypick-only patch train.

anita: note on PR 4335: perf eval shows ~4% latency improvement but 0.6% tail increase on long sequences. need input on risk/benefit.

mike: thanks — let's gate 4335 behind a second perf run with a longer tail sample. if tail >1% regress, we drop from this train.

kevin: rolling back kernel on canary nodes in 2m. I'll mute alerts for those nodes temporarily.

release-bot: kernel-rollback job queued by kevin. job id: jb-7782. estimated disruption: 2m node restarts.

sara: plan: let kevin run rollback -> observe 10m -> if ok, proceed to full rollout; if not, cut patch-only train. anita, mike, can you prioritise the cherry-picks landing order: 4321, 4330, then hold 4335 pending perf pass?

anita: yep will land 4321/4330 asap after CI. 4335 on hold.

mike: monitoring logs + perf dashboards. will report back in ~12m. :eyes:

jen: thanks team. add notes to the release checklist (item: canary kernel rollback + perf gate).

mike: update: after rollback, canary pods restarted and memory OOMs stopped. health checks passing (5/6). continuing bake.

sara: awesome — if it stays green for 10m we go full. otherwise fallback to patch train.

release-bot: canary bake 8m remaining. metrics: p95 latency +2%, error-rate 0.03% -> within SLOs.

anita: CI passed for 4321/4330. landing both now.

mike: confirmed landing and tagging: 4321 -> backport/v2.14, 4330 -> backport/v2.14.

sara: final check: any outstanding approvals or infra tasks?

kevin: no further infra ops. will monitor but no action queued.

jen: I'm good. go time if metrics stay. :thumbsup:

sara: proceeding to full rollout in 2m if bake stays green. thanks all.
